  "reasoning": {
    "A": "Porting the v0 scroll-spy SectionNav is the fastest path to a proven high-value UX for long-form pages, and the 3-hour investment is trivial against launch timeline.",
    "B": "3-step form with progress chips matches the v0 conversion-tested pattern and reliably guides B2B users through required fields; 6 hours is acceptable.",
    "C": "C2 adds the cost-narrative (schedule-risk, no dollar amounts) to reference cards, restoring dossier-noted authority without crossing SB‑4 or requiring video-approval gates.",
    "E": "Slim 4-doc list retains the architect-critical certifications (UL R15140, ASTM E84, IAPMO ER-360) while dropping Plycem-branded brochure and redundant certs, minimizing brand-risk and maintenance.",
    "F": "F4 delivers a compliant index page now, then uses real-world traffic to justify per-city expansion post-launch—best launch-pace vs. SEO trade-off.",
    "J": "J1 instantly restores the CSI specifier hook with a manufacturer-agnostic block; the full 3-part spec can be a post-launch enhancement when bandwidth permits.",
    "P": "P2 preserves inbound /pricing SEO and presents a branded quote-only explanation compliant with SB‑4, a small 1-hour lift.",
    "R": "R3 folds installation content into the Subfloor pillar—aligned with ADR-016—keeping launch surface low while giving the pillar its full authority.",
    "T": "Turnstile alone provides modern, invisible bot defense that’s free on Cloudflare and more robust than a honeypot against AI scrapers, without the complexity of layering.",
    "V": "V3 gives the IAPMO ER-360 certificate both above-fold home visibility (TrustBar) and a deep-dive card in the pillar, maximizing specifier trust signals for a 1.5-hour cost.",
    "Y": "Y2 adds pre-commit WCAG contrast linting at zero runtime cost and prevents silent drift without the integration complexity of auto-export in a single-contributor project."
  },
  "additional_findings": [
    {
      "title": "Turnstile token verification on Cloudflare Workers",
      "description": "The Turnstile server-side verification must run behind /api/submittal in the Next.js Edge runtime; ensure the fetch call to Cloudflare's siteverify endpoint (POST) uses the same AbortController + 10s timeout pattern required by C12.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "4"
    },
    {
      "title": "SubmittalForm field-state persistence across steps",
      "description": "If B1 (3-step) is adopted, step navigation should persist user-entered data across back/forward transitions to prevent data loss; use a lightweight React context or single form state object.",
      "severity": "medium",
      "applies_to_phase": "4"
    },
    {
      "title": "Safari IntersectionObserver rootMargin quirk",
      "description": "v0's scroll-spy uses rootMargin '-80px 0px -60% 0px'; test on Safari 17+ for threshold fire-around when the page uses sticky positioning—some Safari versions exhibit off-by-one rootMargin behavior with percentage bottom margins.",
      "severity": "low",

    }
  ],
